topic: 近一年机器人末端轨迹精度的解决方案与痛点
notes: Scoping review of end-effector trajectory accuracy solutions and pain points over one year (2025-09-01..2026-08-31). arXiv API was network-blocked throughout, so discovery ran through OpenAlex plus targeted WebSearch: 7 retrieval rounds over 206 registered candidates; 62 full texts recovered through the alphaxiv.org markdown mirror (non-OCR); 25 papers deep-read with validated paper notes and passing claim-support audits; 169 evidence events projected with prefix EA-TRAJACC-2026. Coverage/saturation: all six query dimensions, candidate/fulltext/accepted floors, and the two-round saturation gate (new-unique rates 1.05% and 0%) pass. All three reader-facing articles passed citation, trace-map, and editorial quality audits. Four solution families: control-layer compensation (NT-STSM/ILC/backstepping/NMPC), VLA action-chunk smoothing (REMAC/SEAM/PACE/DWS/ACNet/Hermite), VLA latency and asynchrony (SPO/VLASH/ASYNC-3PT), and perception-servoing/force-control evaluation (DET-MPH/FVFC-MTRL/ML2 repeatability).
